catalog.hubDescription: Robots direct from Chinese factories — by category, with prices and lead times.
catalog.hubEmptyText: Prices and descriptions are being added to the sheet — the first ready category will appear here.
catalog.foundCount: Found {count, plural, one {# factory} other {# factories}}
catalog.howToChoose1: Check the founding year and whether the factory exports abroad — export batches go through stricter quality control.
catalog.howToChoose2: Ask about the specific model and its load capacity or purpose — the same factory can make solutions for different tasks.
catalog.howToChoose3: Ask for photos and video of the actual unit's test run before shipping, not generic marketing material.
catalog.howToChoose4: Compare lead times — they vary a lot between factories even within the same category.
catalog.noResultsText: Try widening the filters or describe your task — we'll find a suitable solution.
